Maximum count of characters for the text entry.

- **Read by:** [`enter_text`](../storage/storage_screen.md#enter_text) [`$2CF6`](../../../../src/storage/storage_screen.asm#L475)
- **Written by:** [`storage_screen`](../storage/storage_screen.md#storage_screen) [`$2B56`](../../../../src/storage/storage_screen.asm#L217), [`enter_picture_name`](../storage/storage_screen.md#enter_picture_name) [`$2CBE`](../../../../src/storage/storage_screen.asm#L446)

<a id="disk_command"></a>
### [`disk_command`](../../../../src/data/workspace.asm#L62) `$4F6A-$4F7F`

*variable*

Buffer of 18 bytes for a disk command ($4f6a-$4f7b): "N0:" or "S0:" and a name. The storage scripts at $24b8 and $24d1 write it (op 1 $4f6a, then op 2); the code at $2c7d gives it to SETNAM.
